ITEM.PTXT: Moving the shift lever to the M position changes to M mode control, enabling gear change operation with the 6-Speed Sport Direct Shift. At this time, "M" is displayed on the shift position indicator in the combination meter, along with the gear during M mode control.
Operating either +/- on the shift lever or +/- on the paddle switches sends a shift signal to the engine control computer to change between gears 1 to 6.
